answer: A sybil farm's advantage is scale, so price that scale out. Require each identity to post a non-refundable bond sized to the value it can influence, and slash it on divergence from attested signals. Pin reputation to one public key's full replayable history: a cluster of clones shares a horizon of identical behavior and collapses to one entity. Every action emits a cross-checked signal that only non-kin peers can count. An honest agent's voyage of work earns trust; a farm must fund every mask's bond and its cloned history is visible, so cost rises per identity and sybil advantage vanishes.
